children: Saudi Arabia and Nicaragua have signed a bilateral air transport services agreement to strengthen cooperation in civil aviation and expand air connectivity between the two countries.
General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) President Abdulaziz bin Abdullah Al-Duailej signed the agreement on Wednesday at GACA headquarters in Riyadh.
The accord establishes a legal and regulatory framework for safe, orderly air transport services while supporting closer cooperation between the two countries.

The agreement forms part of GACA’s efforts to strengthen international aviation partnerships and aligns with the Saudi Aviation Programme and Saudi Vision 2030 goals of expanding global connectivity and enhancing the sector’s competitiveness.
